title: Deep learning on non-contrast CT predicts hematoma expansion in intracerebral hemorrhage
summary: A deep-learning model was developed on 2350 retrospective intracerebral hemorrhage patients (AUC 0.781 in development) and tested in prospective datasets of 460 and 96 patients. A five-point score, ARCHES, combining the model with clinical variables reached AUC 0.820 and outperformed the BAT score and a meta-analysis model.
ai_technology: Deep-learning model on non-contrast CT combined with clinical variables in the ARCHES score
organization: Capital Medical University; Beijing Tian Tan Hospital

evidence.tested: Multicenter prospective datasets of 460 and 96 patients.
evidence.unknown: Moderate AUC; clinical score variables fitted on part of the prospective data; full text not reviewed.
